summary: i-80 Gold Corp., a British Columbia company listed on NYSE American and TSX, filed a Form 8-K on September 21, 2026, furnishing an updated Pre-Feasibility Study (PFS) and SEC Technical Report Summary for its Granite Creek Underground Project in Humboldt County, Nevada, effective March 31, 2026. The PFS, prepared by third-party qualified persons including SRK Consulting and others, reports an after-tax NPV (5%) of $118 million and pre-tax NPV of $138 million at a $2,750/oz gold price, with an 8.5-year mine life, 556koz contained gold, and average LOM annual production of 53.9koz. This is a routine technical disclosure, not a special situation.
